verses.text: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
verses.plain: For Ezra had devoted himself to study and to observe the law of the Lord, and to teach its statutes and judgments in Israel.

verses.text: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verses.plain: We had told the king, 'The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him.'
